paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim, chapter 4, halakhah 9; Hyman says it should read R' Yudan, as in Shabbat, chapter 16, halakhah 7.[^1]

notes.text: סה״ט is read as end of halakhah 9, preserving the initial samekh rather than dropping it; פט״ז ה״ז giveschapter 16 halakhah 7 in the connected Shabbat reference. No named edition is independently checked. Supplied איכי/Ikhi differs from earlier audit אימי/Imi and the heading remains provisional. Yudan is Hyman’s emendation, not a new correction; both title abbreviations remain R'.
